title: Cut 4: execution bookkeeping
situation: Cuts of the workflow's plan, open when the design files were seeded into the journal (design/workflow.md, Cuts, at 24543f22); recorded open so that reconstitution reads back what remains, by the architect's ruling of 2026-10-10. Decision 0015 moved this bookkeeping out of cut 2, because code does it reliably and an agent does not.
decision: Realize the work package capability: it takes submitted and updated work packages, checks that every concept is served, hands out computed levels, refuses an empty dispatch, counts whole-check runs per round and flags a round that made no progress.
consequences: Examples 6, 7 and 9 and held-out cases 2, 5 and 7 of cut 2 are re-illustrated here as structural examples.
